title: The gate fails on a clean install, because typecheck resolves the package name through dist
foundBy: session agent, running npm ci and the gate in a fresh sandbox for the first time

evidence.verified: Reverting the fix restores the failure exactly. With `dist/` removed, `npm run typecheck` reports 77 errors and exits 2. With the paths mapping in place it reports 0 and exits 0. Five of the 77 are `Cannot find module "@codesweep-ai/ui"` and the rest follow from them. Moving `src/patterns/patterns.wiring.test.tsx` aside clears all 77 as well, which is what identifies it as the importer. `npm run check` now exits 0 on a tree that has never been built, the condition CI starts from. `docs:compile` still reads `dist/`: without it the gate fails with 51 `Cannot find module` errors, the same count as before the fix.

details:
`npm ci` followed by `npm run check` fails at typecheck on a checkout that has never been built. It reports 77 errors in three preview demo files. Five are `Cannot find module "@codesweep-ai/ui"`, and the rest are the implicit `any` parameters that follow from them.

`src/patterns/patterns.wiring.test.tsx` imports three demos from `preview/src/pages/patterns/`, which pulls those demos into the `tsc` program. Each demo imports the package by its own name. Node resolves a self-reference through the `exports` map in `package.json`, and every entry there points into `dist/`. A tree that has never been built has no `dist/`.

A working copy hides this. Any tree that has run `npm run build` once has a `dist/`, and `check` runs `typecheck` before `build`, so the gate reads output it only produces later in the same run.

CI would fail the same way. The check job runs `npm ci` and then `npm run check` on both Node legs, with no build between them. Nothing on this branch has been pushed, so no run has reported it yet.

The preview and the tests both resolve that import to `src`, through the alias in `preview/vite.config.ts` and the one in `vitest.config.ts`. Only the typecheck reads the built package.

notes.text: The mapping in the root config would have reached `docs:compile` too, because its scratch config extends the root one. That scratch config now clears `paths` explicitly, so a documented example still compiles against `dist/` the way it renders. Removing that override would soften the type half of the gate. The render half resolves `dist/` at runtime and would still catch a broken build.
